deploy-bot: [QUEUE] Deploy request queued for production by @marc. Tag: v2.3.7-hotfix. Reason: hotfix for inference memory leak. Concurrent deploy limit (2) reached in prod. Running: 2. Queue position: 3. Estimated wait per deploy ~6m. Reply with 'cancel' to remove your request or @sre to request priority.
marc: Copy. This is a priority hotfix, needs to go out ASAP. Can we bump it ahead of a noncritical canary? @sara FYI.
sara: What's running currently? any canaries we can abort?
jen: Running: "perf-dashboard-canary" (started by @tyler) and "cli-load-test" (auto). Both are low-risk.
tyler: perf-dashboard-canary is safe to cancel, I can stop it now.
marc: If tyler can cancel, please do — we need one slot.
tyler: /deploy cancel perf-dashboard-canary
deploy-bot: Received cancel request for perf-dashboard-canary from @tyler. Cancelling...
deploy-bot: [CANCELLED] perf-dashboard-canary canceled. Running: 1. Queue position updated. @marc your deploy is now position 2. Estimated wait ~6m.
marc: ok starting: `/deploy start production v2.3.7-hotfix --force`
deploy-bot: @marc: Request queued. Note: force flag noted. Current running: 1. Active concurrency limit 2. Position: 2.
sara: Quick reminder: if this touches model weights or KV cache, prefer blue/green or version pin. Is this a runtime-only fix?
marc: runtime-only patch, no model changes. Will pin to v2.3.7-hotfix. Rollback plan: revert tag to v2.3.6 if metrics degrade.
tyler: Can we shorten change window for this one? small risk.
jen: I'm monitoring infra, will watch latency and error rates. Call me if error rate > 0.5%.
deploy-bot: [START] Deploying v2.3.7-hotfix to production. Triggered by @marc. Commit: 9f3b2a4. Instance pool: prod-pool-a. Canary fraction: 10%.
marc: good luck :rocket:
deploy-bot: [PROGRESS] Migration step 1/4: starting containers. Logs: `no errors so far`
deploy-bot: [PROGRESS] Step 3/4: KV cache warming.
jen: seeing a small spike in token latency on canary, watching.
deploy-bot: [FINISH] Deploy v2.3.7-hotfix succeeded on canary. Promoting to full prod.
marc: promoting.
deploy-bot: [SUCCESS] v2.3.7-hotfix rolled out to production. Duration: ~9m. Origin request: queued due to concurrency limit; completed after cancel freed slot.
tyler: nice.
sara: thanks all. noted rollback plan and metrics check.
marc: will follow up with release note and changelog entry.
